remaining_tasks.name: 18.1-06 Android UAT and restore-flow regression fix
remaining_tasks.progress: All migration/editor/export UAT evidence is recorded and automated validation is green. The direct Restore a backup flow launches a blank/hanging DocumentsUI activity on the Pixel. An uncommitted share-receiver workaround was explored but the owner rejected it because it does not repair the Restore button flow.

blockers.description: The Pixel DocumentsUI picker hangs only when Orbit launches ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT for a result. Direct Restore remains broken. The current uncommitted share-receiver implementation is a rejected workaround, not a valid completion.
blockers.workaround: Investigate and fix the direct Restore button path; do not commit or represent the Files→Share→Orbit path as the product resolution without an explicit owner decision.

decisions.decision: Reject the share-only inbound restore workaround.
decisions.rationale: The owner requires the Restore button to work directly; moving the user to Files→Share→Orbit does not meet that behavior.

uncommitted_files: files-*.xml, orbit-*.xml, share-chooser.xml, orbit-*.png (debug captures; inspect before retaining or deleting)
next_action: Read the phase checkpoint and debug session, inspect the uncommitted direct-picker experiments, preserve them without committing, then find a real direct Restore button fix or explicitly present a product decision instead of silently shipping a workaround.
